Five legal 14-player rosters using your fixed keepers, actual 2025 auction availability, and ESPN league-specific scoring.
Budget / roster: $200, 14 players. Starters: QB, 2 RB, 2 WR, TE, FLEX, D/ST, K; five bench spots.
Fixed in every roster: Malik Nabers ($34) and Brian Thomas Jr. ($10). Remaining budget: $156 for 12 players.
Other teams' 20 keepers are unavailable. Every nonkeeper auctioned by another manager costs the recorded auction amount + $1.
Ian Bates nonkeeper purchases retain their recorded auction price. Missing weekly leaderboard entries (bye/inactive/non-scoring) are treated as 0.
Weekly score is hindsight best-ball: the highest-scoring legal nine-player starting lineup is selected from each 14-player roster.
Ranking score = Weeks 1–14 starter points + 2 × Weeks 15–17 starter points. Floor, median, and standard deviation show consistency.

Alternatives differ by at least two players. Search evaluated 449,508 legal rosters and polished the strongest local optima; results are optimized alternatives, not a proof of the global mathematical optimum.
Interpretation: a higher regular-season floor/median is steadier for head-to-head qualification; playoff average isolates Weeks 15–17 upside.
